# DİDİ Otel Sapanca

> DİDİ Otel, Sapanca Kırkpınar'da göl ile orman arasında bir butik oteldir. Açık havuz (Sapanca'nın tek klorsuz havuzu), konaklamaya dahil kahvaltı (Mare Gastro'da tabak kahvaltı; serpme kahvaltı fiyat farkıyla), bahçe cabanaları ve sahasındaki Mare Gastro restoranı ile hizmet verir. Sapanca merkeze 3 km, İstanbul-Ankara otoyolu Sapanca gişelerine 500 m, Sabiha Gökçen Havalimanı'na yaklaşık 95 km mesafededir. Beş oda tipi sunar: King Suit, Junior Suit, Superior, Aile ve Triple.

## Temel Bilgiler
- [Odalar ve Suitler](https://www.sapancadidiotel.com/#odalar): King Suit, Junior Suit, Superior, Aile ve Triple oda tipleri; kapasite ve donanım.
- [Mare Gastro Restoran](https://www.sapancadidiotel.com/#mare): Otel bahçesinde Akdeniz mutfağı ve deniz ürünleri; rezervasyon.
- [Havuz ve Bahçe](https://www.sapancadidiotel.com/#havuz): Sezonluk açık havuz, bahçe cabanaları, şezlonglar.
- [Konum ve Ulaşım](https://www.sapancadidiotel.com/#konum): Adres, harita, havalimanı ve merkez mesafeleri.
- [İletişim](https://www.sapancadidiotel.com/#iletisim): Telefon, WhatsApp, e-posta, giriş/çıkış saatleri.

- [Sapanca Macera Parkı ve Zipline](https://www.sapancadidiotel.com/blog/sapanca-macera-parki-zipline/): Zipline, dev salıncak ve ip parkurları; aileler ve gençler için.

- [Sapanca'da Sonbahar](https://www.sapancadidiotel.com/blog/sapancada-sonbahar-rehberi/): Ekim–kasım hava (MGM normalleri), renk rotası, gün batımı saatleri.
- [Sapanca'da Yılbaşı 2027](https://www.sapancadidiotel.com/blog/sapanca-yilbasi-tatili/): 31 Aralık perşembe; uzun hafta sonu planı, aralık havası, ulaşım ve oda seçimi.
- [Ormanya Rehberi](https://www.sapancadidiotel.com/blog/ormanya-rehberi/): Kartepe Uzuntarla'da doğal yaşam parkı; Kırkpınar'a ~13 km, giriş ve saat notları.
- [Kartepe Kayak Merkezi Rehberi](https://www.sapancadidiotel.com/blog/kartepe-kayak-merkezi-rehberi/): Sapanca'dan 25–30 dk; pist/lift bilgisi kaynaklı, kış yolu ipuçları.
- [Sapanca Gölü Hakkında Bilgiler](https://www.sapancadidiotel.com/blog/sapanca-golu-hakkinda-bilgiler/): ~45 km², ort. 36 m / en derin ~52 m, içme suyu; yüzme ve güvenlik.
- [Ankara'dan Sapanca'ya Nasıl Gidilir](https://www.sapancadidiotel.com/blog/ankaradan-sapancaya-nasil-gidilir/): YHT ile Arifiye ~2 sa 37 dk, günde 6 sefer; araçla ~320 km.
- [Havalimanından Sapanca'ya Ulaşım](https://www.sapancadidiotel.com/blog/havalimanindan-sapancaya-ulasim/): Sabiha Gökçen ~95–110 km, İstanbul Havalimanı ~170 km; transfer, araç, YHT.
- [Sapanca'da Yazın Yapılacaklar](https://www.sapancadidiotel.com/blog/sapancada-yazin-yapilacaklar/): Klorsuz havuz, SUP, Maşukiye, Kartepe yaylası, gün batımı ~20:30.
- [Sapanca'da Yağmurlu Havada Ne Yapılır](https://www.sapancadidiotel.com/blog/sapancada-yagmurlu-havada-ne-yapilir/): Kuzuluk termal, Taraklı, lezzet turu; aylara göre yağışlı gün tablosu.
- [Sapanca'da Toplantı ve Şirket Kaçamağı](https://www.sapancadidiotel.com/blog/sapancada-toplanti-ve-sirket-etkinligi/): Toplantı salonu, trenle ulaşım, ekip aktiviteleri ve planlama listesi.
- Tüm yazılar: [Blog](https://www.sapancadidiotel.com/blog/)

## Bilgiler
- Adres: Kırkpınar, Sapanca / Sakarya, Türkiye
- Telefon: +90 264 592 12 12 · WhatsApp: +90 533 135 08 88
- Giriş 14:00 / Çıkış 12:00
- Kahvaltı konaklamaya dahildir: Mare Gastro'da tabak kahvaltı olarak servis edilir; serpme kahvaltı fiyat farkıyla sunulur.
- Mare Gastro 00:00'da kapanır (son sipariş 23:00); 15:00'ten sonra çocuk kabul edilmez.
- Diller: Türkçe, English, العربية, Deutsch, Русский

## English Blog
- [How to Get from Ankara to Sapanca: High-Speed Train, Car and Bus Guide](https://www.sapancadidiotel.com/en/blog/ankaradan-sapancaya-nasil-gidilir/): The fastest way from Ankara to Sapanca is the YHT to Arifiye (about 2h 37m), then a 13 km taxi. Current train times, the 320 km drive and a weekend plan.
- [Getting from the Airport to Sapanca: Sabiha Gökçen and Istanbul Airport](https://www.sapancadidiotel.com/en/blog/havalimanindan-sapancaya-ulasim/): Sabiha Gökçen to Sapanca is ~95–110 km: transfer, rental car or bus plus YHT options. Istanbul Airport is ~170 km away. Journey times and practical tips.
- [Getting from Istanbul to Sapanca by Train: Ada Ekspresi, High-Speed Rail (YHT) and Timetables](https://www.sapancadidiotel.com/en/blog/istanbuldan-trenle-sapanca/): Istanbul to Sapanca by train: the YHT does not stop at Sapanca, so take Marmaray + Ada Ekspresi or the YHT to Arifiye. Current times and how to reach the hotel.
- [Kartepe Ski Resort Guide: Staying in Sapanca and Skiing in Kartepe](https://www.sapancadidiotel.com/en/blog/kartepe-kayak-merkezi-rehberi/): Kartepe Ski Resort is 25–30 minutes from Sapanca. Pistes, lifts, sledding, winter road tips, a family plan and where to stay between the lake and the forest.
- [Kuzuluk Hot Springs Guide: A Thermal Break from Sapanca](https://www.sapancadidiotel.com/en/blog/kuzuluk-kaplicalari-rehberi/): Where are the Kuzuluk hot springs, how hot is the water, how far from Sapanca? The Akyazı thermal spring, health warnings and a Sapanca + Kuzuluk weekend plan.
- [Ormanya Guide: Hobbit Houses and a Nature Park, 15 Minutes from Sapanca](https://www.sapancadidiotel.com/en/blog/ormanya-rehberi/): Where is Ormanya, is entry free, when is it open? Hobbit houses, walking trails, getting there from Sapanca (~13 km) and a half-day plan for families.
- [Marriage Proposal in Sapanca: Venues, Timing and Preparation Guide](https://www.sapancadidiotel.com/en/blog/sapanca-evlilik-teklifi-organizasyon/): Proposing in Sapanca: lake shore and cable car ideas, sunset times by month, and cake, candlelight and table decoration at Mare Gastro if booked in advance.
- [What to Do at Lake Sapanca: SUP, Cycling, Walking and Birdwatching](https://www.sapancadidiotel.com/en/blog/sapanca-golu-aktiviteler/): What to do at Lake Sapanca? SUP, shoreline walks, cycling in Uzunkum, birdwatching and sunsets. The lake's real dimensions and the safety rules to follow.
- [About Lake Sapanca: Depth, Size and Can You Swim in It?](https://www.sapancadidiotel.com/en/blog/sapanca-golu-hakkinda-bilgiler/): How many km² is Lake Sapanca, how deep is it, can you swim? The lake's ID card, drinking water and protection work, water level, birds and safety warnings.
- [A Guide to Zipline, ATV and Adventure Activities in Sapanca](https://www.sapancadidiotel.com/en/blog/sapanca-macera-parki-zipline/): Where is the zipline in Sapanca? Zipline and ATV at the cable car's upper station, rope courses in Maşukiye, SUP on the lake. Who it suits, safety and plans.
- [Sapanca, Abant or Bolu? A Weekend Getaway Comparison](https://www.sapancadidiotel.com/en/blog/sapanca-mi-abant-mi-bolu-mu/): Sapanca, Abant or Bolu? Distance from Istanbul, altitude, climate, train access and season in one table. Sapanca for a short break, Abant for real snow.
- [Sapanca Cable Car Guide: Ticket Prices, Hours and the Line from Kırkpınar](https://www.sapancadidiotel.com/en/blog/sapanca-teleferik-rehberi/): Sapanca Teleferik ticket prices (full 450 TL, student 300 TL), 11:00–19:00 hours, the 1,501 m line from Kırkpınar and zipline and ATV at the top station.
- [New Year in Sapanca: A Planning Guide to Welcoming 2027 by the Lake](https://www.sapancadidiotel.com/en/blog/sapanca-yilbasi-tatili/): New Year in Sapanca 2027: 31 December is a Thursday, a long-weekend chance. December weather, Kartepe, the cable car, traffic tips and how to choose a room.
- [Things to Do in Sapanca: A Guide to the Lake, Cable Car, Maşukiye and Kartepe](https://www.sapancadidiotel.com/en/blog/sapancada-gezilecek-yerler/): Things to do in Sapanca: the lakeshore, cable car, Maşukiye, Ormanya, Kartepe and Lake Poyrazlar. Real drive times from Kırkpınar and notes on the best seasons.
- [What to Eat in Sapanca: Local Flavours and Where to Try Them](https://www.sapancadidiotel.com/en/blog/sapancada-ne-yenir/): What to eat in Sapanca? Protected-origin ıslama köfte, Abhaz cheese, pumpkin dessert, trout in Maşukiye and Circassian mezes, with a what-and-where table.
- [Autumn in Sapanca: An October–November Travel Guide and Fall Colour Route](https://www.sapancadidiotel.com/en/blog/sapancada-sonbahar-rehberi/): Autumn in Sapanca: October–November weather, rainy days, colourful forest routes (Maşukiye, Kartepe, Ormanya), sunset times and a 2-day itinerary for your stay.
- [Meetings and Company Retreats in Sapanca: A Guide to Team Getaways Near Istanbul](https://www.sapancadidiotel.com/en/blog/sapancada-toplanti-ve-sirket-etkinligi/): Company meetings and team retreats in Sapanca: 1.5–2 hours from Istanbul, easy train access, a meeting room, team activities and a planning checklist.
- [What to Do in Sapanca When It Rains: 8 Indoor and Covered Ideas](https://www.sapancadidiotel.com/en/blog/sapancada-yagmurlu-havada-ne-yapilir/): What to do in Sapanca in the rain? Thermal pools in Kuzuluk, roaring Maşukiye waterfalls, Taraklı, an ıslama köfte tour and hotel downtime. Monthly rain table.
- [Things to Do in Sapanca in Summer: Pool, SUP, Highlands and Sunsets](https://www.sapancadidiotel.com/en/blog/sapancada-yazin-yapilacaklar/): What to do in Sapanca in summer? A chlorine-free pool, SUP on the lake, stream-side coolness in Maşukiye, Kartepe highlands, the cable car, Ormanya and sunsets.
- [How to Get to Sapanca: A Guide by Car, Train, Coach and Airport](https://www.sapancadidiotel.com/en/blog/sapancaya-nasil-gidilir/): How to get to Sapanca: 1.5–2 hours by car from Istanbul; Ada Ekspresi, YHT + Arifiye, coach, Sabiha Gökçen and Ankara options, plus a handy distance table.
